GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Improved 2 Lengths to track leaders on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (1L from lead) @ cutaway. Hit lead 3 Wide @ 100m & held on late. # Had perfect run.
Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, plodded home # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the early stages when wide without cover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping bumped with another runner.
